rules.statement: The term 'business' under section 11(3) of the Income Tax Ordinance (Cap. 188) can refer to multiple agricultural undertakings, not just a single business.
rules.supporting_quote: "I hold, therefore, that section 11 (3) contemplates the possibility of a planter who buys several estates commencing several agricultural undertakings in respect of those estates."

meta.parties: Dias v. Commissioner of Income Tax
